notes: The booklet is dark and low-detail, so exact stud positions were inferred. The piece counts and types match the 69-piece parts list exactly (18 lines).
Steps 1-4: two 4x10 black plates form an 8x10 base. Four 1x8 tiles ring it, with the printed tile at the front. Two grey 4x6 plates fill the interior, and four grey 1x6 tiles frame them.

Step 5: the 6x10 interior is filled with the 2x2 plate, six jumpers, the 1x4 tile and two 1x2 tiles. The tower sits on the jumpers, and the curved brick sits on the 2x2 plate (stacked with the second 2x2 plate from step 6).
Steps 6-8: nine alternating courses of a 2x3 brick plus a 1x3 brick form the 3x3 tower core.

Steps 9-11: three stages, each a 2x2 brick with a corner brick on top. The 1x1 tiles of steps 10-12 cap exposed studs of the top core course. Steps 12-14: three courses of a 1x3 and two 1x1 bricks (ids b52-b61) build the two-prong top.
Step 15: three 1x1 tiles cap the remaining studs. Step 16: three 1x2 bricks are stacked on the 1x3 prong. Step 17: two antennas go on the top 1x2 brick.
Where a brick overhangs or sits above a tile, only pieces whose studs it actually clutches are listed in rests_on. No pins, axles or hinges are used, so other_joins is empty.
